statement: For restricted property received for services, the capital-gain holding period begins at the date of acquisition when a § 83(b) election was made, and at the date the property became substantially vested when no election was made (IRS Publication 525, Restricted Property / Holding period).
caveat: This drives long-term capital gain timing and interacts with holding-period-dependent regimes (e.g. the § 1202 five-year clock). For option stock the acquisition is the exercise; facts on transfer and vesting dates are legal determinations.
